papers.title: Collecting Infrastructure-Level Measures for Energy Analysis in Modern Computing Infrastructures
authors: Isac Pasianotto, Stefano Cozzini, Niccolo Tosato
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2611.22160v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Modern HPC facilities are complex environments in which all components are tightly coupled; consequently, precisely modeling and accounting for energy consumption requires approaches that go beyond instrumenting individual compute nodes. Aiming for a cluster-wide vision, we designed a scalable data collection pipeline that aggregates fine-grained measurements from multiple subsystems-spanning component loads, software and hardware counters, sensors and energy-ensuring consistent sampling frequencies and synchronized data acquisition across the infrastructure.
